root.label: Static reflection (C++26)
root.note: P2996 and companions: compile-time values that represent program constructs, queried with <meta> and spliced back into code.

children.label: Lift and lower
children.note: ^^ turns a construct into a std::meta::info; [: r :] turns a constant info back into code.

children.label: ^^ operator
children.note: Accepts ::, namespaces, templates, type-ids and id-expressions; parses the longest possible type-id.

children.label: Splicers
children.note: [:r:] needs a constant expression; add typename or template to disambiguate, obj.[:m:] for members.

children.label: Aliases stay distinct
children.note: ^^Int != ^^int for using Int = int; dealias gives the underlying type.

children.label: Compile time only
children.note: Reflection values never exist at run time, so they cost nothing there.

children.label: Consteval-only types
children.note: info and anything containing it may only be constexpr, a template parameter object, or live inside one evaluation.

children.label: Immediate functions
children.note: A function with an info in its type must be consteval or immediate-escalating, such as a constexpr template.

children.label: meta::exception
children.note: Metafunctions throw on bad input; an uncaught throw makes the expression non-constant (P3560).

children.label: Querying <meta>
children.note: Over two hundred consteval functions in std::meta.

children.label: Names
children.note: identifier_of throws without has_identifier; display_string_of text is implementation-defined.

children.label: Members
children.note: members_of, nonstatic_data_members_of, enumerators_of, bases_of return vector<info> in declaration order.

children.label: access_context
children.note: current(), unprivileged() or unchecked(): private members appear only if the caller opts in.

children.label: Values and templates
children.note: reflect_constant and extract convert values; substitute builds template specializations.

children.label: Writing code
children.note: Turning computed reflections into declarations and statements.

children.label: template for
children.note: P1306 expansion statement: body instantiated per element; break and continue are allowed.

children.label: define_static_array
children.note: Copies a vector<info> into static storage so template for can iterate it.

children.label: define_aggregate
children.note: Completes an incomplete class from data_member_spec descriptions, only inside a consteval block.

children.label: consteval blocks
children.note: consteval { ... } runs code at namespace or class scope; the only place injected declarations may come from.

children.label: Annotations
children.note: P3394: [[=expr]] attaches structural constants that only reflection reads.

children.label: Every one counts
children.note: [[=1, =1]] gives two annotations; redeclarations add more to the same entity.

children.label: Reading them
children.note: annotations_of and annotations_of_with_type, then extract<T> to get the value.

children.label: Limits and support
children.note: What C++26 reflection does not do, and where it compiles.

children.label: No general injection
children.note: Only aggregate definitions can be generated; no functions, statements or expression reflection.

children.label: Order matters
children.note: Queries see only preceding declarations, so results can differ by translation unit.

children.label: GCC 16
children.note: Implemented behind -std=c++26 -freflection; expansion statements need only -std=c++26. Clang 21 lacks it.
